questions.question: What Python decorator creates abstract methods?
What can abstract classes contain besides abstract methods?
questions.explanation: Abstract classes can mix abstract and concrete methods.

questions.question: What allows interfaces to have method implementations?
questions.explanation: Default methods provide implementations in interfaces.

What programming approach focuses on contracts?

questions.question: What C++ feature enables abstraction?
questions.explanation: Pure virtual functions create abstract classes.

questions.question: What allows multiple implementations of same contract?

questions.explanation: Default methods add implementations to interfaces.

questions.question: What C++ syntax makes a virtual function pure?
questions.explanation: Appending = 0 declares a pure virtual function.

questions.question: What Java 17 keyword restricts which classes may extend a class?
What C# keyword must a class use to implement an abstract method?
questions.explanation: C# requires the override keyword on implemented abstract members.

questions.question: What is providing a body for an inherited abstract method called?
questions.explanation: Subclasses override abstract methods by implementing them.
